legacy_http.selection: Whole order total_num and all purchase carts; no item selection input.

implemented.principal: Genuine live Supplier manage admission and exact current source MAC; no Customer/Admin principal or serialized execution capability. Existing owner-only recovery survives manage withdrawal.
implemented.first_goods: Protected global goods operations are inspected without active-refund filters. Require one actual complete whole receipt, original payment/supplier identity and full mature deep verification. Archived/cancelled/missing first business evidence fails closed and never resets money budget.

compact_protocol.historical_source_rule: Validate compact canonical bytes and their protected hashes. current_source_hash is produced from the real current full Source under live admission, then fixed in the immutable operation. Historical recovery does not invent or replay a changed source/MAC.

implemented.exact_chain: Actual immutable operation+decision+completion sets are equal; closed proof, canonical JSON/hashes, identities, first receipt references, complete historical prefixes and numeric before->after continuity match. The chain starts at the original goods amount and ends at actual order.refundPrice, within actual paid money; local payment-channel rows are forbidden.
implemented.baseline: Opaque WeakMap capability bound to original txid/backend, exact complete current selected-row hash, specified first refund/order and materialization fingerprint. Only selected.refundPrice comparison gets a first-amount view; every other current field and default deep assertion remains actual. Only Supplier coordinator/executor explicitly compose it in this phase; default readers still reject actual cumulative12.00 versus first7.00, as the native test proves. Other authorized Customer/Admin read surfaces require their own explicit future composition, with no cross-realm grant expansion or automatic projection.
implemented.atomicity: Actual cumulative-order CAS, yue account delta and bill/offline negative platform flow, supplier_transaction, immutable operation+decision+completion share one SQL transaction. Deferred SQL writers run before final complete source/account/effects/chain/deep readback.

new_money_effects.yue: One real pay_product_refund/now_money/pm1/status1 bill with full SR link and supplier_proactive_money_refund event, and exact actual account delta including a negative starting balance.
new_money_effects.offline: One actual negative capital_flow row keyed by full original UUID, exact payment/tenant/order identity and frozen full-row proof hash.
new_money_effects.cash: Cash confirmation required, no new user balance bill or platform capital flow.
new_money_effects.supplier_transaction: One independent actual type2/pm0 per-payout audit row; original orderNo link, current amount, original totalPrice, zero postage, short lossless SR business identity.

implemented.unchanged_goods_effects: No repeated goods finalizer/materializer, stock, points, coupon, commission or supplier goods settlement. Original active SFW ID set remains exactly its frozen income/expense pair, with complete row hashes unchanged.
implemented.unregistered_effects_budget_guard: Before minting the baseline or publishing any available amount, compare all actual same-orderNo SR supplier_transactions and dedicated proactive capital_flow rows against the already validated row-ID sets, including archived rows. A buyer dedicated money-bill SQL anti-join requires protected operation/decision/completion raw identities, full UUID SR suffix, CP proof.bill.id and actual same-SR supplier transaction/order attribution. Registered other-order bills are classified without reading their goods/deep chain, while any unknown marker refuses the budget; no buyer-wide200 cap is introduced. Actual orphan bill/flow/transaction each rejects seed and a new UUID execute from the earlier quote with no writes. A genuine same-buyer other-order goods7.00+money1.00 leaves this order quote6.75 available.
implemented.recovery: Every money receipt proves the complete protected chain and actual current bill/flow/transaction rows; absent decision/completion or any same-SR extra bill is not committed success. Explicit absent fences additionally query actual user_bill/capital_flow/supplier_transactions by the lossless SR full-UUID suffix globally, so isolated historical financial rows cannot be sealed not_applied by either original owner21 or another authorized actor22. The three actual single-table orphan cases create no operation/completion and require both actors to fail closed without ACL expansion. Today account balance may legitimately change after the original payout.
implemented.invoice: First18.75 original whole invoice remains frozen/reconciled through the existing v3 reader; first cash7.00 and all later money operations preserve its original identity/amount.
